description: Check a structured buyer situation (category, company size, country, requirements) against every published offering and get each offering's fit or exclusion with reasons, limitations and unknowns. Each result states its group: fit (fit_state strong_contextual_fit), possible fit (possible_fit), insufficient information (insufficient_information) or excluded (eligibility excluded, with the reason). The list is ordered by more documented fit reasons first, then fewer cautions, then fewer unknowns, then offering id; it is not sorted by group, so group the results by those fields when presenting them. Payment, client status and ownership by ACI's operator are not inputs to the order. ACI publishes no scores and no paid positions. Use when the situation maps to the schema categories; for plain-language needs use search_offerings. free_text is accepted but not interpreted: only the structured fields decide fit.

situation.description: The one shape for a matching situation, used both as the POST /api/v1/match request body and, once extracted from free text or guided answers, as the 'interpreted_situation' echoed back in match-response.schema.json. SEARCH_AND_MATCHING.md §2: all fields are optional, but an incomplete situation must be surfaced, not silently assumed.

free_text.description: Original query, retained for debugging per SEARCH_AND_MATCHING.md §7. Never used as profile evidence.
